  (:objects
    r0 - rover
    w0 w1 - waypoint
    l0 - lander
    s0 - store
  )
  (:init

    (available r0)
    (visible w0 w1)
    (can_traverse r0 w0 w1)
    (store_of s0 r0)
    (empty s0)
    (at_lander l0 w1)
  )
  (:goal (and (at r0 w1)))
)
